description: Core permissions for the Nibbin desktop shell. Grants the main app webview the event plugin (listen/emit) so native→UI signals work — e.g. the C6 hotkey-pause re-render (study:paused-by-hotkey) and the sign-out re-boot. Scoped to the local main webview only; the embedded Grove webview loads remote content and is not listed (no `remote` field), so it gets no Tauri permissions.
